snippet.title: Taxi Chaos 2 Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Taxi Chaos 2 is back. Faster, louder, and more chaotic than ever.

Jump behind the wheel in San Valeda, a living city ruled by autonomous TaxiBots. As one of the last human drivers, you race against time, traffic, and ruthless AI rivals who react to every move. Every shift brings new hazards, blocked routes, hidden shortcuts, and passengers who change the rules mid ride. From fragile cargo to rockets strapped to the trunk, no two runs play the same.

Inspired by classic arcade taxi driving with a modern twist, Taxi Chaos 2 blends pick up and play action with permanent progression, vehicle upgrades, and global leaderboards. Master vertical routes, outdrive aggressive TaxiBots, and push your score higher with every shift.

Launching 23 December 2025. Perfect for fast sessions, family play, and holiday chaos.

Available on
Steam PC
Nintendo Switch
Xbox Series X|S

Epic Games Store and PlayStation 5 on 13 January 2026
